rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday verb for leaving a place or person.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 jyun4 faan6 zau6 lei4 hoi1 laa3

rows.meaning: set out, leave on a journey
rows.note: Use this when someone sets out on a journey, especially when stating the departure time or destination.

example.english: We depart for Taipei at eight tomorrow morning.
example.traditional: 我哋聽朝八點出發去台北。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ting1 ziu1 baat3 dim2 ceot1 faat3 heoi3 toi4 bak1

rows.note: Use this when a person, thing, or phenomenon vanishes or ceases to be seen or present.

example.english: The morning fog will soon depart.
example.traditional: 朝早啲霧好快就消失晒喇。
example.jyutping: ziu1 zou2 di1 mou6 hou2 faai3 zau6 siu1 sat1 saai3 laa3

rows.note: Use this polite euphemism specifically for a person who has died.

example.english: Our uncle had to depart from this world last month.
example.jyutping: baa3 baa3 soeng6 go3 jyut6 gwo3 san1 laa3
